program.blurb: Every day a different subject from the moving shelves: cardio, combat, yoga, Pilates and care.
program.about: Twenty subjects from the cardio, combat, yoga and mobility shelves, one a day. HIIT, jumps, running, court work, boxing, kickboxing, Pilates, balance, back care, mobility and more each come once before any comes back, then a short lift. Each time it is a different format. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
